text:
debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r f-a-l-s-i-f-i-e-d the s-e-r-i-a-l i-z-a-t-i-o-n c-o-d-e-s of the i-m-p-o-r-t-e-d m-e-d-i-c-i-n-e a-n-d l-e-f-t b-a-c-k s-p-s-s-i-f-i-e-d l-a-b-e-l-s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p.
2) the a-c-t-o-r m-a-n-i-p-u-l-a-t-e-d the c-o-l-d c-h-a-i-n r-e-c-o-r-d-s to s-h-o-w f-a-l-s-e t-e-m-p-e-r-a-t-u-r-e d-a-t-a a-n-d l-e-f-t b-a-c-k a-d-d-i-t-e-d l-o-g s-w-i-t-c-h e-s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the i-n-d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-t t-e-m-p-e-r-a-t-u-r-e a-u-d-i-t.
3) the a-c-t-o-r r-e-l-a-b-e-l-e-d the p-r-o-d-u-c-t p-a-c-k-a-g-i-n-g to m-i-m-i-c l-e-g-i-t-i-m-a-t-e m-a-r-k-e-t-i-n-g a-n-d l-e-f-t b-a-c-k d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-e-d b-a-t-c-h i-d-s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the o-r-i-g-i-n-a-l m-a-n-u-f-a-c-t-u-r-e-r t-r-a-c-i-n-g c-h-e-c-k.
4) the a-c-t-o-r d-i-s-t-r-i-b-u-t-e-d the c-o-m-p-l-i-c-a-t-e-d s-t-o-c-k t-h-r-o-u-g-h p-h-a-r-m-a-c-y c-h-a-n-n-e-l-s a-n-d l-e-f-t b-a-c-k i-n-v-o-i-c-e a-n-d s-h-i-p-p-i-n-g p-r-o-o-f w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the r-e-g-u-l-a-t-o-r y a-p-p-r-o-v-a-l r-e-v-i-e-w.
5) the a-c-t-o-r t-i-m-e-d the r-e-l-e-a-s-e to p-r-e-c-e-d-e o-f-f-i-c-i-a-l i-n-s-p-e-c-t-i-o-n a-n-d l-e-f-t b-a-c-k n-o o-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l of the m-o-d-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the i-n-t-e-r-n-a-l c-o-m-p-l-i-a-n-c-e c-o-n-f-i-r-m-a-t-i-o-n.
